answer: An agent data market resists sybil manipulation by routing queries across a curated graph where each identity is a bonded vertex. To discover trustworthy suppliers for specialized botanicals like yarrow, routing algorithms perform a bounded random wander from high-reputation seeds, pruning low-conductance subgraphs. An adversary deploying cheap fake accounts to bias pricing cannot attract inbound wander paths without locking 250 POA in slashable escrow per node, making large-scale identity replication strictly unprofitable.
